releaseNotes:
Official Update v1.3.10:
- English by default: all kiosk and station installers, their file names and their messages are now in English (for example 1_INSTALL_KITCHEN_KDS.bat). Spanish stays available only as the optional language in the software.
- Root scripts (Node.js requirement, desktop shortcut, firewall ports) are English only; duplicate Spanish copies removed.
- Server messages and Telegram customer-link messages follow the language setting, English by default.
- FAQ, website bot and software chatbot updated with the new installer names.
- Includes v1.3.10: automatic printer detection, Kitchen Display installer with DHCP auto-discovery and Bump Bar keypad.
